guards.step_title: Places (Místa) tab, POI sheets and community submissions
guards.situation: While the place catalogue and community places are still loading, the customer cannot see or pick any place; the list waits until both sources are in.
guards.old_where: 4.1.3(70a94933) lib/features/routes/all_pois_screen.dart:424-425 (sourcesLoading = catalogPoisProvider/userPoisProvider loading with no data) and :522-528; current lib/features/routes/all_pois_screen.dart:441-442, old path :645

guards.verdict_evidence: The v2 branch (all_pois_screen.dart:484) uses the same sourcesLoading value computed at :441 before the branch, and shows a loading skeleton instead of the list.

guards.step_title: Places (Místa) tab, POI sheets and community submissions
guards.situation: If the place catalogue or community places fail to load (for example offline), the customer gets no places.
guards.customer_sees: Only the generic empty text 'poiEmpty' with a map emoji; nothing says loading failed.
guards.verdict_evidence: v2 is stricter than the old look: it shows an error card with a retry button that invalidates catalogPoisProvider and userPoisProvider; the same providers feed both looks.

guards.situation: Community places that are not yet approved (the customer's own pending suggestions or anyone else's) are not offered in the Places list or map.

guards.situation: The list only offers places that pass the current filter (search text, categories, countries, minimum rating, chosen route, 'nearby' radius) and is sorted by the chosen order.
